newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy may not suffer much from US-Iraq row.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy may not suffer much from US-Iraq row.

text.p: Japan's giant economy is seen facing marginal damage from the latest U.S.-Iraq confrontation, which has pushed up global oil prices, economists in Tokyo said on Wednesday.
Any rapid surge in oil prices in theory should worsen Japan's inflationary picture by boosting imported prices, but many doubt if the current oil price surge would last for long.

"In theory, a 10 percent rise in oil prices could push up wholesale prices here by 0.2 point a year, and the impact would become larger if that combined with another rapid yen plunge," said Soichi Okuda, a senior economist at NCB Research Institute.
